'''Drakag''' were hulking but quick-witted creatures native to [[Seline]]. They were unknown to the galaxy until the [[Galactic War]] when a conflict on Seline brought them to the attention of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who used them as beasts of burden on the planet's rough terrain.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Drakags appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as player mounts available from the "Spoils of War" Cartel Pack.
